full_judgment: 2. The petitioners filed Writ Petition No. 343 of 1987 challenging the acquisition of .2068 acres of land appertaining to CS Plot Nos. 29 and 30 of Khatian Nos. 4512 and 4514 respectively situated to the north of the homestead of the petitioners who are washermen. The acquisition was challenged, inter alia, on the ground of non-compliance with the provisions of the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance (No. II of 1982), briefly, the Ordinance.
